summary.name: DevOps Foundations: Site Reliability Engineering
summary.one_liner: A 1h 20m advanced online course from Lynda.com (now LinkedIn Learning) by James Wickett and Ernest Mueller that introduces site reliability engineering (SRE) and how it fits into DevOps.
use_cases: Learning the basics of SRE and how it fits into DevOps
Preparing for a site reliability engineer job role
Defining reliability targets with SLAs and SLOs
Scaling systems and teams with SRE practices
summary.what_it_does: The course introduces the basics of site reliability engineering and how SRE can be integrated into a particular business environment. It covers release engineering, change management, incident management and retrospectives, self-service automation, troubleshooting, performance, and deliberate adversity. It explains how to define reliability through SLAs and SLOs, handle crises, design distributed systems, and scale systems and teams. It also touches on time and project management strategies for SRE work.
notable: Taught by James Wickett and Ernest Mueller
Offers a shareable certificate for LinkedIn profiles, PDF, or image
caveats: Short course at about 1h 20m, introductory in scope
Page does not state whether the course is free or requires a subscription
